Name: Gamepad Slot Fix
Author: neoiw
Description:
[size=6][b][color=#2E75B6]Gamepad Slot Fix[/color][/b][/size]

[b][color=#808080]Nexus #（53830）  ·  Version 1.1.0  ·  by BraveTurtle  ·  Stardew Valley 1.6+ / SMAPI 4.0.0+  ·  Windows[/color][/b]

[line]
[center][/center]

[center][size=3]Controller plugged in but dead — or in split-screen only the second pad works? That is a phantom device holding a player slot.[/size][/center]

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#2E75B6]English[/color][/b][/size]

[size=4][b][color=#7030A0]▸ What it fixes[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]A pad that is plugged in but ignored until you unplug and replug it.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Split-screen where the main-screen player has no input while player 2 plays fine.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Cheap 1-to-2 / composite HID receivers exposing extra devices with no stick and no D-pad — they no longer grab a player slot.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Which player gets which pad changing when you use a different USB port or plug them in a different order.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#7030A0]▸ What it does[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][b]Device ledger:[/b] every launch lists each controller's stick / D-pad / button counts and judges it usable or not — in the SMAPI log, so you can check it yourself.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Rebuilds the player slot table:[/b] slots are cleared and refilled with usable devices first, so slot 1 (main screen) always gets the first real pad.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Hot-plug aware:[/b] plugging or unplugging a pad re-checks the mapping instead of leaving a dead slot.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Manual assignment:[/b] pin a controller to player 1–4; device keys survive USB port changes and driver reinstalls.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Whitelist safety net:[/b] if a real pad is ever judged unusable, whitelist it and it is always used.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Fail open:[/b] every internal failure is caught and the original code path continues — a broken mod never stops you from playing.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#7030A0]▸ In-game menu (GMCM, optional)[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Toggles for "enable this mod" and "explain skipped devices in the log".[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Player 1–4 dropdowns listing the controllers found on this launch — no JSON editing.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Read-only ledger summary: how many devices were found, which were judged unusable.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Works with Generic Mod Config Menu 1.16.0; without GMCM everything still works through [font=courier]config.json[/font].[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#7030A0]▸ Install[/color][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer (smapi.io).[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Unzip the [font=courier]GamepadSlotFix[/font] folder into your [font=courier]Mods\[/font] directory — it must contain [font=courier]manifest.json[/font] and [font=courier]GamepadSlotFix.dll[/font].[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Start the game. [font=courier]config.json[/font] is created on first launch.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#7030A0]▸ Verify it works[/color][/b][/size]
[size=3]Search the SMAPI log for [font=courier][GPADSLOT][/font]. A healthy launch ends with:[/size]
[code][GPADSLOT] devices=4
#0 key=VID_20BC&PID_5500&MI_02&COL02 axes=0 buttons=24 hats=0 → SKIP
#1 key=VID_20BC&PID_5500&MI_02&COL01 axes=0 buttons=3  hats=0 → SKIP
#2 key=VID_20BC&PID_5500&MI_01       axes=6 buttons=15 hats=1 → USE
#3 key=VID_20BC&PID_5500&MI_00       axes=6 buttons=15 hats=1 → USE
[GPADSLOT] startup: GamePad 槽位表 before: count=4 keys=[0,1,2,3]；需要重建槽位=True
[GPADSLOT] 槽位重建 done: 释放=[0,1,2,3] 按计划补登记=[2,3] 槽位表 after: count=2 keys=[0,1][/code][size=3]After the rebuild the count should equal the number of real pads and the keys should start at 0 — slot 1 now holds a real controller.[/size]

[size=4][b][color=#7030A0]▸ Notes & safety[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][b]No device, driver, registry or game-file changes; no save-file writes; no network access.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Delete [font=courier]Mods\GamepadSlotFix[/font] to revert completely.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Set [font=courier]EnableAutoFilter: false[/font] to keep the mod installed but inactive (no hooks at all).[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Windows verified on real hardware (Stardew Valley 1.6.15, SMAPI 4.5.2); macOS/Linux unverified.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]MIT licensed. Source code is in the source download.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[line]



[center][/center]

[center][size=3]手柄插着却没反应，或者分屏里只有第二只手柄能用？那是伪设备占住了玩家槽位。[/size][/center]

[size=4][b][color=#7030A0]▸ 它修什么[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]手柄插着却被无视，非要拔插一次才认。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]分屏下主屏玩家完全没有输入，第二只手柄却能正常玩。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]便宜的一拖二／复合 HID 接收器多报出"没有摇杆、没有十字键"的伪设备 —— 它们不再抢走玩家槽位。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]换 USB 口、或者插拔顺序一变，"谁是谁"就跟着变。[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#7030A0]▸ 它做什么[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][b]设备台账：[/b]每次启动列出每只手柄的摇杆数/十字键数/按键数与判定结果，写进 SMAPI 日志，你可以自己核对。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]重建玩家槽位表：[/b]先清空槽位，再按"可用设备优先"的顺序放回去 —— 第 1 号槽（主屏）永远给第一只真手柄。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]热插拔也管：[/b]插拔后重新核对映射，而不是留下一个死槽位。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]手动指定：[/b]可以把某只手柄钉给玩家 1~4；设备键是硬件标识，换 USB 口、重装驱动都不变。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]白名单保险丝：[/b]万一真手柄被误判，加进白名单就永远可用。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]失败即放行：[/b]任何内部异常都被捕获并放行原版流程 —— 模组出问题也不会让你玩不了游戏。[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#7030A0]▸ 游戏内菜单（GMCM，可选）[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]两个开关：启用本模组、在日志里说明跳过了哪些设备。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]玩家 1~4 下拉框：直接列出本次读到的设备键，不用手改 JSON。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]只读台账摘要：本次识别到几台设备、哪几台被判为不可用。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]支持 Generic Mod Config Menu 1.16.0；没装时 [font=courier]config.json[/font] 照常可用。[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#7030A0]▸ 安装[/color][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]先装 SMAPI 4.0.0 或更高（smapi.io）。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]把 [font=courier]GamepadSlotFix[/font] 文件夹解压进 [font=courier]Mods\[/font]，里面应有 [font=courier]manifest.json[/font] 与 [font=courier]GamepadSlotFix.dll[/font]。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]启动游戏；首次运行会生成 [font=courier]config.json[/font]。[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#7030A0]▸ 怎么确认它在工作[/color][/b][/size]
[size=3]在 SMAPI 日志里搜 [font=courier][GPADSLOT][/font]，一次正常启动的关键几行长这样：[/size]
[code][GPADSLOT] devices=4
#0 key=VID_20BC&PID_5500&MI_02&COL02 axes=0 buttons=24 hats=0 → SKIP
#1 key=VID_20BC&PID_5500&MI_02&COL01 axes=0 buttons=3  hats=0 → SKIP
#2 key=VID_20BC&PID_5500&MI_01       axes=6 buttons=15 hats=1 → USE
#3 key=VID_20BC&PID_5500&MI_00       axes=6 buttons=15 hats=1 → USE
[GPADSLOT] startup: GamePad 槽位表 before: count=4 keys=[0,1,2,3]；需要重建槽位=True
[GPADSLOT] 槽位重建 done: 释放=[0,1,2,3] 按计划补登记=[2,3] 槽位表 after: count=2 keys=[0,1][/code][size=3]重建之后 count 应等于真手柄数量、键从 0 起连续 —— 说明第 1 号槽已经是真手柄。[/size]

[size=4][b][color=#7030A0]▸ 说明与安全[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][b]不碰设备、不碰驱动、不碰注册表、不改游戏文件、不写存档、不联网。[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=3]删掉 [font=courier]Mods\GamepadSlotFix[/font] 即完全还原。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]把 [font=courier]EnableAutoFilter[/font] 设为 [font=courier]false[/font] 可以保留模组但完全不生效（不安装任何钩子）。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]已在 Windows 实机验证（星露谷 1.6.15、SMAPI 4.5.2）；macOS / Linux 未验证。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]MIT 许可；源码在源码包里。[/size][/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Gamepad Slot Fix
Manifest.Description: Assigns game controllers to player slots by usability instead of enumeration order, and registers controllers at startup when the framework only registers them on hot-plug. Controllers with no analog stick and no D-pad (a common artifact of composite / 1-to-2 USB receivers) no longer take a player slot, and you can pin a device to a specific player from config.json. No device, driver or system change; delete the mod folder to fully revert.
Manifest.Author: BraveTurtle
